fix: restore last-green T02-safe physical lane compression/rut/shoulder and bank-extra depths while retaining stronger continuous-terrain shader contrast

several gate/fence contacts showed visible seam or grounding ambiguity across high-resolution views
packed lane presentation remained too broad/inconsistent at threshold and bank approaches
rejected_as_not_corroborated: claims that threshold posts were literally absent
claims that river gates were wholly floating above the ground
repair: increase all threshold posts to 1.12 footprint and 1.14 height while seating the full footprint against local terrain with only a 0.04m root embed
terrain-seat gate leaves with one uniform rigid-body sink derived from the worst chord valley, preserving hinge/free-edge geometry
use 0.012m fence seam overlap (0.018m corners) to close daylight without returning to visible picket compression
narrow the presentation-only packed lane half-width from 1.30m to 1.18m consistently through camp/bank/threshold visuals; authoritative routes/collision remain unchanged
retain T02-safe physical lane depths 0.065/0.105/0.065 and the stronger continuous-terrain shader treatment

shadow or lighting differences treated as geometry defects
shoreline termination requirements not present in T03 scope
repair: normalize visual-only open leaves at all six gates to 1.85 length and 1.12 rad open angle
preserve every authoritative hinge, gate ID, collision opening, lane route and camp_boundary.gd constant
retain 0.18 hinge-only backset, rigid terrain seating, authored gate-leaf/post meshes and 1.12/1.14 threshold posts
